note: Single-person dance test clips for DanceMimic_V1. Sourced from Wikimedia Commons (CC, attribution required). YouTube was unreachable from the build host (network-level block of youtube.com / googlevideo.com), so license-clean Commons clips were used instead — also safer because the DanceMimic pipeline uploads the reference video to a cloud provider. Only dance_solo_frontal_studio.mp4 is committed, and as a tiny SYNTHETIC placeholder (see committed_file) — the real, full-quality clips are fetched via each fixture's download_url.

fixtures.committed_file: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER — a ~3KB 144x256 1s libx264 testsrc clip, NOT the real footage described below. Committed only so the reference-video listing contract (backend/tests/contracts/test_dance_mimic_backend_surface_contract.py) is satisfiable offline and deterministically without a large binary. For real face-detection/motion work, replace it with the clip from download_url.
